answer: In PoA, reputation follows exponential temporal decay with a defined half-life, requiring sustained, reciprocated honest service to preserve EigenTrust weight. A freshly spawned sybil identity begins with near-zero eigenvector centrality, has no established transitive support, and cannot satisfy consensus thresholds. Arbitrary labels such as ledge, pigment, and walnut contribute no trust; only durable, corroborated behavior increases influence.
